traits: beat the block game on hardcore with half a heart (day 4)
ate a billion burgers, which launched him into space on a cartoon poop jet; belly deflated back to a stick (day 5)

rocked a mom's baby to sleep and fell asleep holding it; she kissed him on the cheek and he blushed (day 6). The mom (O.draw_mom: long brown hair + bun, pink dress) shops at the burger place - callback possible

EXPELLED FOREVER from wizard school (day 7): read his acceptance letter, sprinted into the 9 3/4 wall and bounced off, used the door in the wall instead, the giant talking hat found no brain in his head (hello... echoed) and blasted him into the empty white room

flew a plane (day 8): took off from the FLIGHT SCHOOL airfield, looped until he went green, climbed out of the atmosphere into space, puked a zero-g blob (back to normal), fell back down on fire and planted the plane nose-first in the field; the flaming puke landed next to him. He looks completely normal again (no soot, no tint).

went to green hill (day 9): collected rings deadpan, ran until his legs were a blur wheel, ran a giant loop, RINGS 999, blasted past the GOAL sign and skidded to a stop; victory stance with a peace sign; the most harmless little ladybug robot puttered up, poked him and knocked him flat on his back; every ring burst out of him (RINGS 0). Looks normal.
world.notes: Day 9 RE-CUT 2 on Justin's notes: no banner; the bug's poke knocks him down (arc back, flat on his back), rings burst; Mega Drive-style FM music (original tune: slap bass, brass lead, PSG arps). Parody is fine (SHOW.md).

used_comments: Rock a baby to sleep. (My mom said this)

history.summary: walks in, pulls giant clipboard from where a pocket would be, writes TELL ME WHAT TO DO NEXT IN THE COMMENTS, holds it up, blinks
no comments on day 1; holds the sign, turns it, writes I'LL WAIT. under the message, dead stare (21 s)
still no comments on days 1-2; holds the sign (with I'LL WAIT. on it), turns it, writes STILL HERE. under the message, dead stare (21 s)

@neoblade75 (IG): 'Beat Mc in hardcore mode:)' -> full-screen cards: DAY 1 punches a log out of a tree (top floats); NIGHT 1 in a dirt pillar; DAY 41 drops into the floor portal; STILL DAY 41: black blocky dragon swipes him to half a heart, he pulls a pixel sword, flurry of hits, one last tap, it dissolves; victory text scrolls beside him; drops the sword and does the ask right there in the End (71.8 s)

@nerdbpy (IG): 'Eat a billion big Mac’s' -> RE-CUT on Justin's outline: reads the card in the End, walks right into a new world with a red/yellow burger place; a dump truck backs in and dumps 1 BILLION BURGERS on him; head pops out of the pile; unwraps and eats them one bite each, faster and faster (BURGERS LEFT counter), belly swelling, wrappers piling up; struggles through the last two; huge belly, exhausted; eyes go wide; a cartoon poop jet launches him into the sky (loops, flips, a twirl past clouds and stars) while the belly deflates; falls and lands on his butt; stands; deadpan ask in front of the store (69.2 s)

@nerdbpy (IG): 'Rock a baby to sleep. (My mom said this)' -> RE-CUT on Justin's outline: a mom hands him her baby and runs into the burger place; it cries, he's frazzled; he cradles and rocks it to sleep, then falls asleep too (Zzz); she comes back, eats a burger in one bite, takes the baby, kisses his cheek; he blushes; she runs off; deadpan ask, blushing (56.5 s)

@nerdbpy (IG): 'Join Hogwarts.' -> RE-CUT 2 on Justin's notes: owl drops the letter; he reads it, shows us YOU'RE IN.; owl points; he sprints into the 9 3/4 brick wall, bounces off, stars; owl points again: a DOOR TO WIZARD SCHOOL in the same wall; through it to the castle; the giant talking hat checks his head (hello... echoes): THERE'S NO BRAIN IN THIS HEAD. EXPELLED. FOREVER. -> blasts him into the empty white room; the letter follows him down, EXPELLED stamped across it; deadpan ask (72.6 s)

@second_degree_burn (IG): 'Fly a plane' -> RE-CUT on Justin's notes: white room -> airfield; takeoff; loops until his face goes green; keeps climbing into space; engine dies in the silence; pukes a zero-g blob (back to normal); long stare; plane drops; re-entry on fire; crashes nose-first into the airfield (giant dust cloud); flung out onto his butt; the flaming puke splats beside him; deadpan ask on the airfield (65.6 s)

@nicolascechettoschuller (IG): 'Go to green hill' -> RE-CUT on Justin's notes: airfield -> walks into a generic green hill (music kicks in); rings; run; blur legs; giant loop; RINGS 999; blasts past the GOAL sign, skids; sign spins and lands on his face; victory stance + peace sign, jingle; a tiny ladybug robot putters up very slowly, pokes him and knocks him flat on his back; every ring bursts out (RINGS 0); bug leaves; he sits up, stands; deadpan ask (57.8 s). Original Mega Drive-style FM music + game-style SFX.
